verdict.rationale: Vendor docs confirm APM agents for major languages, infrastructure agents for hosts/containers/providers, OpenTelemetry support for hosts and Kubernetes, and cloud spend/Kubernetes visibility plus AWS Lambda integration, covering the breadth of the story. However, community reports describe fragile in-cluster collection services and past logging-agent bugs that undercut reliability of these integrations in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of Kubernetes/cloud integrations, and resolution of reported agent fragility/log-loss issues.
